name: It's a Book – Money Low, Funny Though
description: An independent book fair featuring a symposium, bringing together independent publishers, artists, designers and readers. Around 80 independent publishers and publication projects will present books, magazines, zines and editions. The fair offers an overview of current practices in independent publishing and creates space for direct encounters between producers and the public. The accompanying symposium brings together voices from publishing, music and cultural theory to explore the significance of independence today. Despite being in Leipzig, it represents a significant event in the German independent publishing circuit relevant to Berlin's cultural community.
